description: This file defines a Java interface `WithDittoHeaders` that provides a contract for classes to handle `DittoHeaders`. It declares methods to retrieve and set `DittoHeaders`, with a focus on immutability by returning new instances upon setting headers.

methods.name: getDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns the DittoHeaders associated with this object.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets the DittoHeaders and returns a new object with the updated headers, throwing NullPointerException if the argument is null.
